scope: CORE-02.T03 incremental pre-start opacity and atomic staging verification; not task acceptance
implemented: Public record-bound staging returns a payload-free StagedOutbox receipt.
OutboxMessage and raw stage/load paths are hidden from downstream crates; raw loading is test-only outside internal transaction helpers.
Public claims contain only IDs and lease expiry; claim construction does not deserialize or hash payload bytes.
PayloadHashMismatch no longer exposes expected or actual payload hashes.
The just-inserted outbox projection is reloaded and checked inside the same IMMEDIATE SQLite transaction before commit.
An injected AFTER INSERT projection rewrite is rejected and rolls back the outbox row, operation transition and journal mutation.
